2025 TOMRA AS4/AS5 Optical Training Course

Training location

VDRS Headquarters, 360 Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Drive, Norwalk, CT 06854 

This training program is designed for managers and mechanics working in MRFs equipped with Autosort 4/5 scanners. The purpose of the training is to increase the mechanics’ knowledge of TOMRA operations and to improve communication with the Van Dyk service department in troubleshooting over the phone. The training will consist of one (1) day of classroom lecture and two (2) days of hands-on experience with the respective machine. The participants will be troubleshooting and replacing parts under the supervision of a Van Dyk specialist.

Who should attend?

Operators or Mechanics who would like a better understanding of how to maintain, troubleshoot and repair a TOMRA Autosort machine.

Prerequisites required of all trainees

  • Basic knowledge of electrical circuits
  • Basic familiarity with TOMRA optical sorters
  • Fine mechanical skills

For pricing, accommodations, full syllabus, and other questions, please email training@vdrs.com.

 

Schedule Your Class
